Alan Lomas, a "lost contact," of Merton, and Rutlish, whom he met in the R.A.F. at Ludlow. Alan has since visited us at Belgrave Hall, looking very fit and well.

Allan Lomas, our chubby Rutlish member, is now with the R.A.F. in Canada. Had a good journey out, a very happy week in Massachussetts, where the Americans gave him a good time—iced beer which you can't knock back quickly; but New Brunswick, where he is stationed, is "dry"—one has to have a licence to get a drink!
Alan Lomas whom we have not heard of for some time now, is, presumably, still in Canada and busy with Flying Courses. His father writes that he sends him news of the Club's doings.
Jim Beer is still out in India, and still keeps in touch with the Club through his parents. Alan Lomas is a Sgt.
